start: A member linked by a check-in; the trainer took measurements and sent a diet plan

steps.action: Open Progress, then Body
user_sees: The gym's entries beside the member's own, marked 'From <gym> · <trainer>'
History note 'Ask your gym to change the ones they recorded.'
must_not: A day counted twice when the member logged the same day

steps.action: On the Gym tab tap 'Diet plan'
user_sees: Screen 'Diet plan' with the plan title, meals and times, '1,600 kcal · 120 g protein a day'
'Talk to a doctor if you have a health condition.'

start: A member; two diet plans from the trainer

steps.action: Look at the 'Diet plan' row on the Gym tab
user_sees: '2 plans from your trainer'

steps.action: Open 'Diet plan'
user_sees: Both plans, each with its meals

start: A member not linked yet, or the gym sends nothing

steps.action: Open 'Diet plan' before any check-in
user_sees: 'Check in once to see your diet plan' and 'Scan <gym>'s check-in QR at the gym. After that, the plan your trainer sends shows here.'
must_not: A diet plan of someone with the same number

steps.action: Open it when no plan was sent
user_sees: 'No diet plan yet' and 'When your trainer at <gym> sends you a diet plan, it shows here by itself. Ask them if you'd like one.'

steps.action: Try to change a gym measurement on the Body page
user_sees: It cannot be changed; the history says to ask the gym
must_not: The gym's number changed on the phone

steps.action: Leave the gym, then open Body and the Gym tab
user_sees: The gym's measurements already on the phone stay, marked with the old gym's name
No diet plan row (diet plans go with the gym)
must_not: The old gym's diet plan still shown

steps.action: The trainer fixes a measurement; the member opens Body after 10 minutes
user_sees: The fixed value
must_not: Both the old and the new value

start: A member; own measurements and photos on the phone

steps.action: Log own weight and photos, then look at what the gym gets
user_sees: The gym's list stays separate and read-only
must_not: The member's own entries or photos sent to the gym
Body weight in the trainer summary
